text:
alex: heads up — saw a weird conversion gap when onboarding mosaic/mpt-7b-chat -> redwood. converter finished but the chat template and the special system token got dropped. reproducible locally.

alex: command I used:
```
redwood-hf-convert --model-id mosaic/mpt-7b-chat --revision v2 --output /tmp/mpt-convert
```

alex: logs looked fine at the end (exit 0) but tests fail because eval harness expects a `<|system|>` token and the converted tokenizer has no mapping for it. also no `chat_template.json` in the artifact.

maria: :eyes: can you paste the tokenizer.json snippet?

alex: sure — this is the relevant part from the converted artifact: 
```json
"special_tokens_map": {},
"added_tokens": [
  {"id": 1, "content": "<|pad|>"},
  {"id": 2, "content": "<|user|>"},
  {"id": 3, "content": "<|assistant|>"}
]
```

maria: interesting — so `<|system|>` is missing entirely. on HF the repo had `special_tokens_map` pointing at `{\"system_token\": \"<|system|>\"}`?

alex: exactly. in the HF repo the tokenizer.json contains `"special_tokens_map": {"system":"<|system|>"}` and there is a `chat_template.yaml` at the root. converter artifact lacks both.

jia: my hunch: converter downloads the model revision pin (you passed `--revision v2`) but our hub client sometimes resolves tags differently. if `v2` is a lightweight tag that changed the file pointers (index vs merged shards) converter may be pulling the weights from the tag but the tokenizer/chat template from default branch because of a cached refs mapping. we've seen that mismatch before. can you run with `--revision main` or explicitly `--repo-type=auto` and re-run?

alex: tried `--revision main` and it preserved everything. so seems like a revision resolution bug. but also saw a warning about safetensors index merging earlier in logs: `WARNING: merging safetensors index from multiple refs, keys may be renamed`. maybe that is related.

sam: I dumped the hub responses — when the repo has a mixture of safetensors shards + a separate `tokenizer.json` update in a different commit, our downloader's index merge path can skip non-shard files when the `safetensors.index.json` indicates a different tree. result: file list becomes incomplete. this explains missing chat_template.

sam: another clue — tokenizer added_tokens ids in converted artifact overlap with `bos` id 0 on some runs. that caused prompt concatenation issues during eval (we saw prompt tokens clobbered).

maria: sounds like two bugs: 1) revision pin resolution leading to partial file lists, and 2) safetensors index merge step that accidentally filters non-weight files. both are plausible.

jia: I'll open a patch branch to force filelist reconciliation after any index merge: if there is a `tokenizer.json` or `chat_template.*` present in any resolved tree, always download it regardless of shard index. simple whitelist. I'll also add a repro test that uses a repo with `v2` tag pointing to a commit that changes only shards.

sam: add a quick workaround to the converter: if `special_tokens_map` is empty but `added_tokens` contains \"<|assistant|>\" and \"<|user|>\", assume missing system token and log a non-fatal warning instead of silently continuing. that will reduce silent regressions in evals.

alex: thanks. can you link the PR and also add a short note to the onboarding checklist: "verify chat_template & system token present after convert"? we lost a day of debugging on a customer bring-up because of this.

jia: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/convert/merge_requests/2345 (draft) — tests failing on one CI vector (deploy-bot pasted below).

deploy-bot: CI failure (convert-compat): job `convert-compat/mosaic-mpt-chat` failed — exit code 1 — see job logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/convert/2345/logs

maria: great. once the PR is up please ping #eng-ml and #devex so we can add the checklist entry and rerun onboarding tests. thanks for the quick triage everyone. :thumbsup:

alex: dropping my local reproducer in case anyone wants to try: `./tools/repro-hf-convert.sh mosaic/mpt-7b-chat v2`

sam: noted — will try to escalate if CI flakes after patch.
